name: io.github.kolivritech/kolivri-voice-mcp
description: Kolivri AI Voice MCP Server — real phone line for AI agents with KYC & rate-limit guards.

environmentVariables.name: KOLIVRI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Kolivri API key sent in the x-api-key header for authenticated voice calls.

environmentVariables.name: KOLIVRI_VERIFIED_CALLER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated KYC-verified outbound caller IDs in E.164 or Israeli format.

environmentVariables.name: KOLIVRI_MAX_CALLS_PER_MINUTE
environmentVariables.description: Maximum outbound calls per minute per API key (default 5).

tools.name: kolivri_place_call
tools.description: Place an outbound AI voice call via Kolivri Engine with KYC verified-caller and anti-abuse rate-limit protection.

tools.name: kolivri_get_call_status
tools.description: Retrieve structured call status, outcome, transcript, summary, appointment status, and recording URL for a Kolivri call.

tools.name: kolivri_carrier_forwarding_codes
tools.description: Generate 30-second GSM/carrier call-forwarding dial codes (*61*, *67*, *62*, *21* and ##002# reset) for Israeli telecom carriers.

tools.name: kolivri_preview_roi
tools.description: Calculate SMB missed-call revenue loss and recommend the matching Kolivri unified plan (Starter $69 / ₪247, Business $139 / ₪479, Pro $249 / ₪880).
